decisionNodes.stem: Given {patientName}'s confirmed disease and completed skeletal assessment, which next management approach is appropriate?

answerChoices.label: Continue observation because no complication was found
Obtain neck ultrasound before discussing surgery

decisionNodes.explanation: For confirmed asymptomatic primary hyperparathyroidism, age under 50 years independently supports parathyroid surgical assessment. The age-appropriate normal bone-density report does not replace that criterion.
